label: Deribit Options & Futures
notes: The key's scopes must include trade:read_write and must NOT include wallet:read_write or account:read_write.
terms_note: JSON-RPC over HTTP GET (/api/v2/<method>?params); private methods take HTTP Basic client credentials. Errors are HTTP 400 JSON-RPC error objects. place_order and cancel_order move real funds.

discovery.auth: client_id + client_secret (HTTP Basic, or public/auth bearer)

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of a Deribit API key (Account > API). Give it trade:read_write and NOT wallet:read_write or account:read_write. A test-environment key comes from https://test.deribit.com and works only against https://test.deribit.com/api/v2 (set adapter.base_url to it).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The key's Client Secret; sent as HTTP Basic credentials (Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret)) on each request over TLS.

me.note: Extended account summaries: account id, username, type (main/subaccount) and per-currency balances.

list_markets.note: Every unexpired instrument across currencies (options, futures, perpetuals, spot) in one response; `query` is not sent. Cached by Deribit for about a minute.

get_ticker.note: `symbol` is a Deribit instrument name such as BTC-PERPETUAL or BTC-27DEC26-100000-C.

list_orders.note: All open orders across currencies; `symbol` and `status` are not sent (the method has no instrument filter).

place_order.note: PLACES A REAL ORDER WITH REAL FUNDS on the configured host; it is not a simulation. Test with the Deribit test environment https://test.deribit.com/api/v2 first (edit adapter.base_url to point there), and never place an order the user has not explicitly confirmed. `side` selects private/buy or private/sell. `quantity` is Deribit's `amount`: USD for perpetuals and inverse futures (multiples of the contract size, e.g. 10), the base coin for options and linear futures. Limit orders need `price` (good_til_cancelled); omit it for market orders.

cancel_order.note: Only the order id is needed.

not_offered.get_candles: public/get_tradingview_chart_data returns columnar arrays (result.ticks[], result.open[], result.high[] ...) rather than one record per candle, and start_timestamp/end_timestamp are mandatory; the result mapper reads row lists and the vocabulary carries no time range.

auth: Private methods over HTTP accept 'Authorization: Basic BASE64(ClientId + : + ClientSecret)' (docs: 'Every private method can be accessed by providing an HTTP Authorization: Basic XXX header'), a deri-hmac-sha256 signature, or a bearer token from public/auth.
Basic is used: a public/auth bearer token expires with HTTP 400 (13009 unauthorized, checked live), which the runtime's re-login-on-401 would not catch, and its expires_in sits under result.

endpoints.notes: currency required (or any); kind, expired optional
last_price, best_bid_price, best_ask_price, mark_price, stats{volume, high, low, price_change}
result.summaries[{currency, balance, equity, available_funds, margin_balance}]; extended=true adds id/username/type
instrument_name, amount or contracts, type (default limit), price, time_in_force; result.order{order_id, order_state}

reference.limits: Credit-based rate limits per account (non-matching-engine vs matching-engine methods); error 10028 too_many_requests arrives as HTTP 400.

evidence: host www.deribit.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 7/7 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 400 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check: the docs pages did not render (login wall, SPA or bot wall)
live read without credentials: get_ticker, list_markets returned data that validates against the vocabulary
